title: FreeCAD InventorLoader current ACIS route qualification refresh
mode: Primary-source add-on README, adapter, and issue tracker review; research-only
scope: Refresh the current qualification status of InventorLoader as an optional SAT/SAB and DXF-inline ACIS comparison route.
Separate standalone SAT/SAB parsing, DXF carrier extraction, native Inventor/Fusion feature reconstruction, and FreeCAD kernel/STEP outcomes.
Determine whether issue #110 provides an upstream fix or only an issue-body workaround.

sources.observed: The add-on documents SAT/SAB and DXF solid import into FreeCAD, no export, and limitations for blending surfaces, some helix surfaces, and law-defined curves without spline data. The README labels the add-on released 1.5.
sources.limitation: The mutable master page is not an immutable artifact pin or proof of current FreeCAD compatibility.

sources.observed: The DXF adapter reads through ezdxf, examines Solid3d entities for sat/sab carriers, passes extracted payloads to the add-on AcisReader, then creates geometry through FreeCAD Part or a STEP strategy.
sources.limitation: This is a composed DXF-to-FreeCAD route, not a DWG parser, AcDs owner/key resolver, or independent geometry kernel. Source was inspected; runtime was not executed.

sources.observed: The issue remains open. Its body reports that demo Dice.sat appeared to import nothing, then supplies a standalone FreeCAD 1.2 macro that uses a locally corrected readText path, explicitly retains the AcisReader, resolves nodes and imports a STEP conversion. The report notes messy face normals on its direct route.
sources.limitation: The macro is a user-provided workaround in an open issue, not a merged upstream fix, released add-on artifact, independently reproduced result, or semantic geometry oracle.

sources.observed: Open report for Windows FreeCAD 1.1 development build and InventorLoader 1.5.1: DXF import raises KeyError: 3, while STEP mode reportedly creates an empty document.
sources.limitation: User report not independently reproduced; scoped to the named route/build.

sources.observed: Both remain open and report an SAB parse error and a SAT shell/face-recognition error, respectively.
sources.limitation: User reports not independently reproduced; no general failure claim is made.

sources.observed: Open report says a FreeCAD weekly 2025-10-15 F3D import did nothing after strategy selection, while STEP reportedly worked in FreeCAD 1.0.2.
sources.limitation: This is the F3D importer route, not direct DWG/DXF or standalone SAT/SAB parsing.

sources.observed: Open Windows FreeCAD 1.1 development report for native IPT import errors, including a Part::Extrusion rejected by a Body; STEP reportedly imports with missing sketch connectivity/constraints.
sources.limitation: This is the native Inventor feature route, not the standalone SAT parser; the issue was not reproduced.

implementation_readiness: Keep InventorLoader optional and composed-checkpoint-only; do not add it to regular build, CTest, or per-slice validation.
Before any use, pin exact add-on commit, FreeCAD build, OS/architecture, selected import strategy, and checksum/hash for any local workaround.
Do not silently apply the issue #110 macro workaround and report it as stock upstream behavior.
Require a fast nonempty-geometry preflight and compare solid count, closed-shell/validity, analytic dimensions, volume and placement; record unsupported geometry and fallbacks.
Keep stock FreeCAD DXF import and the DWG-converter-to-DXF route as separate qualification lanes.
If the optional app/add-on route cannot be pinned or produces no semantic result, mark it NOT_QUALIFIED and continue local implementation.
